title: setup hook --remove --dry-run shows what would be removed and keeps the file
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). After `setup hook --yes`, `--remove --dry-run` prints the diff (`--- a/.claude/settings.json`, `+++ /dev/null` since the file would go) and `dry run, nothing written`; the file is still there byte for byte. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
